system.description:
A life-size jointed figure on strings that run up into the ceiling tracks, in a stage costume of a bellhop, a chef or a guest, its painted face fixed in a sorry smile. It is "alive", and fights for its life.
The ballroom fills: while the marionettes are awake in the ballroom, the Dark Master may spend ☾3 at the end of any round to drop 2 Hotel Marionette mooks within 30', as more lurch down from the wall.
Dream-heart (the aunt only): while it stands, every character in the ballroom with Corruption 5+ is Slowed. In its chest is the silver compass.

It drops a loop of string about a creature within reach and hauls upward along its track. Agility DR12. Success: half of d6. Failure: d6, and Restrained until it escapes (Strength DR12 as ◈). Ruin: d8, Restrained, and lifted off its feet.

outcomes.failure: d6, and Restrained until it escapes (Strength DR12 as ◈).
outcomes.ruin: d8, Restrained, and lifted off its feet.

system.description: It moves only where the ceiling tracks run (nearly everywhere in the hotel). Cutting its strings (an attack that deals 6 or more in one hit) leaves it Prone and unable to stand.
